function normalCvet(hex) {
    let h = String(hex || '').trim();
    if (!h) return '';
    if (!h.startsWith('#')) h = `#${h}`;
    if (/^#[0-9A-F]{3}$/i.test(h)) {
        const r = h[1];
        const g = h[2];
        const b = h[3];
        h = `#${r}${r}${g}${g}${b}${b}`;
    }
    if (!/^#[0-9A-F]{6}$/i.test(h)) return '';
    return h.toUpperCase();
}

function zamenitFonPaneli(cssText, color) {
    const src = String(cssText || '');
    const rx = /\brgba\s*\(\s*0\s*,\s*0\s*,\s*0\s*,\s*(?:0?\.8|0\.80?)\s*\)/gi;
    return src.replace(rx, function () {
        const match = arguments[0];
        const full = arguments[arguments.length - 1];
        const offset = arguments[arguments.length - 2];
        const before = full.slice(0, offset);
        const cut = Math.max(before.lastIndexOf(';'), before.lastIndexOf('{'));
        const since = before.slice(cut + 1);
        if (!/\bbackground(?:-image)?\s*:/i.test(since)) return match;
        return color;
    });
}

function podozdat(condition, callback, options) {
    const opts = options || {};
    const intervalMs = opts.interval || 100;
    const maxAttempts = opts.maxAttempts || 100;
    const warnMessage = opts.warnMessage || 'podozdat: timeout';
    let attempts = 0;

    const tick = setInterval(() => {
        attempts += 1;
        if (attempts > maxAttempts) {
            clearInterval(tick);
            console.warn(warnMessage);
            return;
        }
        try {
            if (condition()) {
                clearInterval(tick);
                callback();
            }
        } catch (_) {}
    }, intervalMs);
}

function klonSoSlezhkoy(target, onChange) {
    const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(target));
    return new Proxy(clone, {
        set(obj, key, value, receiver) {
            const prev = obj[key];
            const result = Reflect.set(obj, key, value, receiver);
            if (prev !== value) onChange(key, value, prev);
            return result;
        }
    });
}

function primenitFonHud(color) {
    const styleEl = window.__uzelStilejHud || window.__epifaceHudStyleEl;
    const template = window.__shablonFonaHud || window.__epifaceHudPanelTemplate || window.__rezervaStilejHud || window.__epifaceHudCssOriginal;
    if (!styleEl || !template) return;
    const nextColor = color || 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)';
    window.__sohranennyjFon = nextColor;
    window.__epifaceHudLastBgColor = nextColor;
    styleEl.textContent = template.replace(/\{\{FON_PANELI\}\}/g, () => nextColor);
}

window.__mostChata = window.__mostChata || {
    baseSendChatInput: null,
    wrap: null,
    rev: 0,
    safeZone: {
        commandPrefix: null,
        tryHandle: null
    },
    radar: {
        tryHandle: null
    }
};

function perehvatChata() {
    const chat = window.__mostChata;
    const current = window.sendChatInput;

    if (typeof current !== 'function') return;

    if (!current.__perehvatChataVkl || chat.baseSendChatInput !== current.__bazovayaFunkciyaChata) {
        chat.rev++;
        chat.baseSendChatInput = current;
    }

    if (window.sendChatInput === chat.wrap && chat.wrap) return;

    const wrap = function(text) {
        if (typeof text === 'string') {
            try {
                if (chat.safeZone.tryHandle && chat.safeZone.tryHandle(text)) return;
            } catch (_) {}

            try {
                if (chat.radar.tryHandle && chat.radar.tryHandle(text)) return;
            } catch (_) {}
        }

        const base = chat.baseSendChatInput;
        if (typeof base === 'function') return base.apply(this, arguments);
        return undefined;
    };

    wrap.__perehvatChataVkl = true;
    wrap.__bazovayaFunkciyaChata = chat.baseSendChatInput;
    wrap.__versiyaPerehvataChata = chat.rev;

    chat.wrap = wrap;
    window.sendChatInput = wrap;
}

function ovalnyjRadar(borderColor) {
    const styleId = 'oval-radar-stili';
    let styleEl = document.getElementById(styleId);
    if (styleEl) styleEl.remove();

    const border = borderColor ? `0.60vh solid ${borderColor}` : '0vh';

    styleEl = document.createElement('style');
    styleEl.id = styleId;
    styleEl.textContent = `
#app .hud-radmir-radar__map {
    width: 26.3vh !important;
    height: 16.9vh !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    display: flex !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    border-radius: 100% !important;
    border: ${border} !important;
}
#app .hud-hassle-map {
    width: 32vh !important;
    height: 32vh !important;
}
#app .hud-radmir-radar__radar {
    width: 26.3vh !important;
}
#app .hud-radmir-radar {
    left: 10.3vh !important;
    bottom: 4.03vh !important;
    transform-origin: left bottom !important;
}
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(styleEl);
}

        'onInfoChange'(e, t) {
            const cfg = window.konfigHud;
            const d = this.data;

            if ((e == 'show' || e == 'showBars') && +t >= 0x1) {
                if (e == 'show') d.showState = 0x1;
                if (e == 'showBars') d.showBarsState = 0x1;
                this.syncVisibility();
            }
            if ((e == 'show' || e == 'showBars') && +t === 0x0) {
                if (e == 'show') d.showState = 0x0;
                if (e == 'showBars') d.showBarsState = 0x0;
                this.syncVisibility();
            }

            if (e == 'weapon') {
                if (d.weaponEl.icon && cfg.weapon[t] !== undefined) d.weaponEl.icon.src = cfg.weapon[t];
                if (d.weaponEl.ammoEl) {
                    if (t >= 0x10) {
                        d.weaponEl.ammoEl[0x0].style.display = '';
                        d.weaponEl.ammoEl[0x1].style.display = '';
                    } else {
                        d.weaponEl.ammoEl[0x0].style.display = 'none';
                        d.weaponEl.ammoEl[0x1].style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }
            }
            if (e == 'health') {
                if (d.hpEl.progress) d.hpEl.progress.style.width = t + '%';
                if (d.hpEl.value) d.hpEl.value.textContent = t;
            }
            if (e == 'armour') {
                if (d.armourEl.progress) d.armourEl.progress.style.width = t + '%';
                if (d.armourEl.value) d.armourEl.value.textContent = t;
            }
            if (e == 'hunger') {
                if (d.hungerEl.progress) d.hungerEl.progress.style.width = t + '%';
                if (d.hungerEl.value) d.hungerEl.value.textContent = t;
            }
            if (e == 'breath') {
                if (d.breathEl.wrapper) d.breathEl.wrapper.style.display = t < 0x63 ? '' : 'none';
                if (d.breathEl.progress) d.breathEl.progress.style.width = t + '%';
                if (d.breathEl.value) d.breathEl.value.textContent = t;
            }
            if (e == 'money') {
                if (d.moneyEl) d.moneyEl.textContent = this.formatMoney(t);
            }
            if (e == 'wanted') {
                if (d.wanted.els) {
                    for (let i = 0x0; i < d.wanted.els.length; i++) {
                        d.wanted.els[i].src = i < t ? cfg.icons.active_wanted : cfg.icons.inactive_wanted;
                    }
                }
                if (d.wanted.wrapper) d.wanted.wrapper.style.display = t > 0x0 ? '' : 'none';
            }
            if (e == 'ammoInClip') {
                if (d.weaponEl.ammoEl && d.weaponEl.ammoEl[0x0]) d.weaponEl.ammoEl[0x0].textContent = t;
            }
            if (e == 'totalAmmo') {
                if (d.weaponEl.ammoEl && d.weaponEl.ammoEl[0x1]) d.weaponEl.ammoEl[0x1].textContent = t;
            }
            if (e == 'freeze') {
                if (d.freeze.value) d.freeze.value.textContent = String(t).padStart(0x3, '0');
            }
            if (e == 'setServer') {
                if (!d.server.image) return;
                if (t <= 0x0) {
                    d.server.image.style.display = 'none';
                    return;
                }
                d.server.image.style.display = '';
                if (cfg.logo[t]) d.server.image.src = cfg.logo[t];
            }
            if (e == 'setBonus') {
                if (!d.server.bonus) return;
                if (t <= 0x1) {
                    d.server.bonus.style.display = 'none';
                    return;
                }
                d.server.bonus.style.display = '';
                const bonusImg = d.server.bonus.querySelector('img');
                const bonusKey = 'bonus' + Number(t);
                const bonusSrc = cfg.icons[bonusKey] || cfg.icons.bonus;
                if (bonusImg && bonusSrc) bonusImg.src = bonusSrc;
                else d.server.bonus.textContent = 'x' + t;
            }
            if (e == 'showGreenZoneTab') {
                if (d.greenZoneEl) d.greenZoneEl.style.display = '';
            }
            if (e == 'hideGreenZoneTab') {
                if (d.greenZoneEl) d.greenZoneEl.style.display = 'none';
            }

    width: 30.5556vh;

    right: 3.67vh;
}

    align-items: center;
}

.speedometr-dannye {

    height: 1.3333199999999998vh;
    width: 2.22228vh;
    opacity: 0.5;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0.5556vh #000);
}
.speedometr-turns .turn__right {
    transform: rotate(-180deg);
    margin-top: 0;
}
.speedometr-turns .speedometr-povorot-vkl {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0.5556vh rgba(0, 0, 0, 0));
    animation: 0.5s linear infinite alternate turn;
}
@keyframes turn {
    0% {
        height: 1.3333199999999998vh;
        opacity: 0.5;
    }

        height: 2.22228vh;
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

        'init'() {
            if (window.__speedometrGotov) return;

            podozdat(
                () => {
                    if (typeof window.interface !== 'function') return false;
                    const hud = window.interface('Hud');
                    return !!(hud && hud.speedometer);
                },
                () => {
                    this.setStyles();
                    const el = this.mountSpeedometer(this.buildHtml());
                    if (el) this.createSpeedometer(el.classList.contains('speedometr') ? el : el.querySelector('.speedometr') || el);
                    if (window.interface('Hud')?.speedometer) window.interface('Hud').speedometer.show = 0x0;
                    window.__speedometrGotov = true;
                    window.naborSpeedometra = this;
                    if (typeof jsLoader !== 'undefined' && jsLoader.log && jsLoader.log.makeLog) {
                        jsLoader.log.makeLog('BOSS_HUD', '[speedometer init] Inited!');
                    }
                },
                { warnMessage: 'Speedometer initialization timeout: window.interface not available' }
            );
        }

(function () {
    if (window.__customSafeZoneInitialized) return;
    window.__customSafeZoneInitialized = true;

    const config = {
        text: ' ',
        iconImageURL: 'https://i.postimg.cc/T3nkT8sB/zone2.png',
        backgroundImage: 'https://i.postimg.cc/T3nkT8sB/zone2.png'    };
    window.forceSafeZoneUpdate = function() {
        updateSafeZoneElements();
    };

    const safeZoneStyles = document.createElement('style');
    safeZoneStyles.id = 'custom-safe-zone-styles';
    safeZoneStyles.textContent = `
        .hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone {
            position: absolute;
            top: -5.5vh;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1vh;
            padding: 1vh 2vh;
            font-family: 'GothamPro Bold', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.85vh;
            color: #f5eded;
            z-index: 10;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        
        .hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone__bg {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            background: ${config.backgroundImage || 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(101, 196, 102, 0) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 50%, rgba(101, 196, 102, 0) 100%)'};
            filter: blur(1.5vh);
            border-radius: 2vh;
            z-index: -1;
        }
        
        .hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone__icon {
            width: 2.5vh;
            height: auto;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        
        .hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone__text {
            white-space: nowrap;
            z-index: 1;
            text-shadow: 0 0.2vh 0.4vh rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(safeZoneStyles);
    function updateSafeZoneElements() {
        const safeZoneContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone');
        safeZoneContainers.forEach(container => {
            container.innerHTML = '';
            const bgDiv = document.createElement('div');
            bgDiv.className = 'hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone__bg';
            if (config.backgroundImage) {
                bgDiv.style.background = config.backgroundImage;
            }
            container.appendChild(bgDiv);
            const imgElement = document.createElement('img');
            imgElement.src = config.iconImageURL.trim();
            imgElement.className = 'hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone__icon';
            imgElement.alt = 'Safe Zone Icon';
            imgElement.onerror = function() {
                console.error('Failed to load image:', config.iconImageURL);
            };
            container.appendChild(imgElement);

            const textSpan = document.createElement('span');
            textSpan.className = 'hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone__text';
            textSpan.textContent = config.text;
            container.appendChild(textSpan);
        });
    }
    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
            if (mutation.addedNodes.length > 0) {
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                    if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                        if (node.classList?.contains('hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone') ||
                            node.querySelector?.('.hud-radmir-radar__safe-zone')) {
                            setTimeout(updateSafeZoneElements, 0);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
    });
    setTimeout(updateSafeZoneElements, 500);
})();

(function () {
    if (window.__radarGotov) return;
    window.__radarGotov = true;

    let currentRadarStyle = null;
    let currentType = 1;
    let radarColor = null;

    const radarTypeNames = {
        1: 'Овальный',
        2: 'Квадратный',
        3: 'Круглый',
        4: 'Прямоугольный'
    };

    const radarTypeKeys = {
        1: 'oval',
        2: 'square',
        3: 'round',
        4: 'rect'
    };

    function getBorder() {
        return radarColor ? `0.60vh solid ${radarColor}` : '0vh solid transparent';
    }

    function getRadarCSS(type) {
        const border = getBorder();
        if (type === 2 || type === 'square') {
            return `
                #app .hud-radmir-radar__map {
                    width: 21.9vh !important;
                    height: 20.9vh !important;
                    border-radius: 2vh !important;
                    border: ${border} !important;
                }
            `;
        }
        if (type === 4 || type === 'rect') {
            return `
                #app .hud-radmir-radar__map {
                    width: 26.3vh !important;
                    height: 16.9vh !important;
                    border-radius: 2vh !important;
                    border: ${border} !important;
                }
            `;
        }
        if (type === 1 || type === 'oval') {
            return '';
        }
        if (type === 3 || type === 'round') {
            return `
                #app .hud-radmir-radar__map {
                    width: 22vh !important;
                    height: 22vh !important;
                    border-radius: 100% !important;
                    border: ${border} !important;
                }
            `;
        }
        return '';
    }

    function normalizeType(input) {
        const raw = String(input || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!raw) return null;
        if (/^[1-4]$/.test(raw)) return parseInt(raw, 10);
        if (raw.includes('овал') || raw === 'oval') return 1;
        if (raw.includes('квад') || raw === 'square') return 2;
        if (raw.includes('круг') || raw === 'round') return 3;
        if (raw.includes('прям') || raw === 'rect' || raw === 'rectangle') return 4;
        return null;
    }

    function applyRadar(type) {
        if (type != null) {
            const n = normalizeType(type);
            if (n) currentType = n;
        }
        if (currentType === 1) {
            if (currentRadarStyle) {
                currentRadarStyle.remove();
                currentRadarStyle = null;
            }
            if (typeof window.ovalnyjRadar === 'function') {
                window.ovalnyjRadar(radarColor);
            }
            return;
        }
        document.getElementById('oval-radar-stili')?.remove();
        if (currentRadarStyle) currentRadarStyle.remove();
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'radar-forma-stili';
        style.innerHTML = getRadarCSS(currentType);
        document.head.appendChild(style);
        currentRadarStyle = style;
    }

    function notifyRadarChange(type) {
        const name = radarTypeNames[type] || String(type);
        if (typeof window.createNotification === 'function') {
            window.createNotification('Смена радаров ScrtiptLoader', `Выбран: ${name}`);
        }
    }

    function setRadarType(type) {
        const n = normalizeType(type);
        if (!n) return;
        currentType = n;
        applyRadar();
        notifyRadarChange(n);
    }

    function openRadarColorDialog() {
        if (typeof window.addDialogInQueue !== 'function') return;
        window.addDialogInQueue(
            '[0,1,"Цвет обводки радара","Введите (#FF0000 или убрать #F000)","Ок","Назад",0,0]',
            '',
            0
        );
        if (typeof window.sendClientEvent !== 'function') return;
        const orig = window.sendClientEvent;
        window.sendClientEvent = function (...args) {
            if (args.includes('OnDialogResponse')) {
                let input = String(args[5] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                input = input.replace('#', '');
                if (/^[0-9a-f]{3}$/.test(input)) {
                    radarColor = '#' + input.split('').map(c => c + c).join('');
                } else if (/^[0-9a-f]{6}$/.test(input)) {
                    radarColor = '#' + input;
                } else {
                    radarColor = null;
                }
                applyRadar();
                if (typeof window.createNotification === 'function') {
                    window.createNotification(
                        'Обводка радара',
                        radarColor ? `Цвет: ${radarColor}` : 'Цвет отключен'
                    );
                }
                window.sendClientEvent = orig;
            }
            return orig.apply(this, args);
        };
    }

    function openRadarDialogMenu() {
        if (typeof window.addDialogInQueue !== 'function') {
            notifyRadarChange(currentType);
            return;
        }
        const list = 'Квадратный<n>Круглый<n>Прямоугольный<n>Овальный<n>Цвет';
        window.addDialogInQueue(
            '[0,2,"Смена радара","Выберите тип радара:","Выбрать","Закрыть",0,0]',
            list,
            0
        );
        if (typeof window.sendClientEvent !== 'function') return;
        const orig = window.sendClientEvent;
        window.sendClientEvent = function (...args) {
            if (args.includes('OnDialogResponse')) {
                const raw = String(args[5] || '').toLowerCase();
                if (raw.includes('квад')) setRadarType(2);
                else if (raw.includes('круг')) setRadarType(3);
                else if (raw.includes('прям')) setRadarType(4);
                else if (raw.includes('овал')) setRadarType(1);
                else if (raw.includes('цвет')) setTimeout(openRadarColorDialog, 100);
                window.sendClientEvent = orig;
            }
            return orig.apply(this, args);
        };
    }

    window.__mostChata.radar.tryHandle = function (text) {
        const msg = String(text || '').trim();
        if (!msg) return false;
        const lower = msg.toLowerCase();
        const isCmd = lower === '/radartype' || lower.startsWith('/radartype ')
        if (!isCmd) return false;
        const parts = lower.split(/\s+/);
        if (parts.length >= 2) {
            const t = normalizeType(parts[1]);
            if (t) {
                setRadarType(t);
                return true;
            }
        }
        openRadarDialogMenu();
        return true;
    };

    window.__upravlenieRadarom = {
        getType: () => currentType,
        getTypeKey: () => radarTypeKeys[currentType],
        getColor: () => radarColor,
        setType: setRadarType,
        setColor: (c) => { radarColor = c; applyRadar(); },
        openMenu: openRadarDialogMenu,
        openColorMenu: openRadarColorDialog,
        applyRadar
    };

    applyRadar();

    const radarObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (currentType === 1) {
            if (!document.getElementById('oval-radar-stili')) {
                ovalnyjRadar(radarColor);
            }
            return;
        }
        applyRadar();
    });
    const startRadarObserver = () => {
        const target = document.querySelector('#app');
        if (!target) return;
        radarObserver.observe(target, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    };
    setTimeout(startRadarObserver, 2000);

    setInterval(perehvatChata, 500);
    perehvatChata();
})();


(function () {
    if (window.createNotification) return;

    const notif = document.createElement('div');
    notif.style.cssText = `
        position: fixed;
        bottom: 40px;
        right: 55px;
        background: #979797a2;
        color: white;
        font-style: normal;
        font-family: "GothamPro Black", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
        font-weight: 700;
        padding: 8px 12px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        z-index: 9999;
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateX(20px);
        transition: opacity 0.12s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
        pointer-events: none;
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(notif);

    let timeout;

    window.createNotification = function (title, text) {
        notif.innerHTML = `<b>${title}</b><br>${text}`;
        notif.style.opacity = '1';
        notif.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            notif.style.opacity = '0';
            notif.style.transform = 'translateX(20px)';
        }, 2000);
    };
})();

(function () {
    let hudHide = 0;

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
        if (event.keyCode === 118) {
            hudHide++;

            const mainSelector = document.querySelector('.staryj-hud-verh');
            const logo = document.querySelector('.staryj-hud-logo');
            const otherSelector = document.querySelectorAll('.staryj-hud-osnova, .staryj-hud-blok, .staryj-hud-dengi, .staryj-hud-rozysk, .staryj-hud-niz, .staryj-hud-green-zone, .speedometr');

            if (hudHide === 1) {
                console.log('нихуя не сделалось, так надо');
            } 
            else if (hudHide === 2) {
                otherSelector.forEach(el => {
                    if (el) el.style.opacity = '0';
                    if (el) el.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                });
                
                if (logo) {
                    logo.style.opacity = '1';
                    logo.style.display = 'block';
                }
                console.log('худ успешно захайдился, лого оставил, как раньше было');
            } 
            else if (hudHide === 3) {
                otherSelector.forEach(el => {
                    if (el) el.style.opacity = '1';
                    if (el) el.style.pointerEvents = 'all';
                });
                
                if (mainSelector) mainSelector.style.display = 'flex';
                
                hudHide = 0;
                console.log('худ вернули');
            }
        }
    });
})();

if (typeof executeFunctionWhen !== "function") {
    window.executeFunctionWhen = function (callback, condition, interval) {
        const tick = setInterval(() => {
            try {
                if (condition()) {
                    clearInterval(tick);
                    callback();
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        }, interval || 100);
    };
}

const oldInfoCard = {
    gameTextInterval: null,
    isBusinessOpen: false,
    openOldInfoCard(params, interfaceName) {
        if (typeof params === "string") params = JSON.parse(params);

        let houseTypes = [
            "Эконом класс",
            "Деревенски дом",
            "Средни класс",
            "Премиум класс",
            "Элитны дом",
            "Эконом класс",
            "VIP класс",
            "Квартира",
        ];

        let type = interfaceName == "Business" ? 1 : 0;
        let name = type == 0 ? params[1] : params[2];
        let roomAmount = type == 0 ? params[4] : params[6];
        let owner = type == 0 ? params[2] : params[3];
        let price = type == 0 ? params[6] : params[5];
        let rent = type == 0 ? params[5] : params[4];
        let paramType =
            type == 0 ? houseTypes.indexOf(params[3].replace("й", "").replace("й", "").replace("+", "")) : params[1];

        params = JSON.stringify([type, name, roomAmount, owner, price, rent, paramType]);

        window.openInterface("InfoCard", params);

        if (name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes("киоск")) {
            executeFunctionWhen(
                () => {
                    const head = window.interface("InfoCard").$el.querySelector(".biz .status");
                    head.classList.remove("status");
                    head.classList.add("text");

                    head.innerHTML = `<span style="color: hsl(336deg 28% 67%)">Свободных полок: ${roomAmount}<span>`;

                    window.interface("InfoCard").$el.querySelector(".params .info-card__data-row .text").textContent =
                        "Налог на продажу";

                    window
                        .interface("InfoCard")
                        .$el.querySelector(".params .info-card__data-row .title").textContent = `${rent}%`;
                },
                () => window.interface("InfoCard") && typeof window.interface("InfoCard").$el !== "undefined",
                100
            );

            return;
        }

        executeFunctionWhen(
            () => {
                const head = window.interface("InfoCard").$el.querySelector(".title .span");

                head.textContent = name;
            },
            () => window.interface("InfoCard") && typeof window.interface("InfoCard").$el !== "undefined",
            100
        );
    },
    onCloseInterface() {
        clearInterval(oldInfoCard.gameTextInterval);
        window.interface("GameText").add(`[3,\"~w~Для взаимодействия нажмите ~g~alt\",500,0,0,0]`);
        window.closeInterface("InfoCard");
    },
    hookAndReplaceNewInfoCard() {
        if (window.__oldInfoCardHooked) return;
        window.__oldInfoCardHooked = true;

        window.App.$refs.Appartament = [
            {
                close: () => this.onCloseInterface(),
            },
        ];

        window.App.$refs.Business = [
            {
                close: () => this.onCloseInterface(),
            },
        ];

        window.openInterface = new Proxy(window.openInterface, {
            apply: (target, thisArgs, args) => {
                try {
                    if (args[0] === "Business") this.isBusinessOpen = true;

                    if (args[0] === "Business" || args[0] === "Appartament") {
                        window.interface("GameText").add(`[3,\"~w~Для взаимодействия нажмите ~g~alt\",3000,0,0,0]`);
                        oldInfoCard.gameTextInterval = setInterval(
                            () =>
                                window
                                    .interface("GameText")
                                    .add(`[3,\"~w~Для взаимодействия нажмите ~g~alt\",3000,0,0,0]`),
                            2000
                        );
                        oldInfoCard.openOldInfoCard(args[1], args[0]);
                        return 0;
                    }
                } catch (error) {}

                return Reflect.apply(target, thisArgs, args);
            },
        });

        this.onKeyDown();

        if (typeof jsLoader !== "undefined" && jsLoader.showConnectedScript) {
            jsLoader.showConnectedScript("info", "Старая карточка бизов/домов");
        }
    },

    onKeyDown() {
        document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
            if (e.repeat) return;

            if (this.isBusinessOpen && e.keyCode === 18) window.sendClientEvent(0, "Business_OnPlayerEnter");
        });
    },
};

(function initOldInfoCardHook() {
    podozdat(
        () =>
            typeof window.openInterface === 'function' &&
            window.App &&
            window.App.$refs &&
            typeof window.interface === 'function',
        () => oldInfoCard.hookAndReplaceNewInfoCard(),
        { warnMessage: 'oldInfoCard: timeout waiting for openInterface/App' }
    );
})();
